free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the evidence strongly supports sampling due to a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone and a concerning PSA velocity of 2.45 ng/mL/yr. This finding is further supported by the PSA rising from 4.9 ng/mL to 7.6 ng/mL, which overrides the statistical prior suggesting deferral. The combination of high-risk imaging and rising PSA necessitates further tissue sampling to clarify the diagnosis.
